title: Vertical Slice Vision and Scope
summary: Defines what the polished slice must prove and which full-product systems are intentionally out of scope.
sourceFile: Vertical Slice/01 - Vertical Slice Vision and Scope.docx

blocks.text: Purpose. Define the small, polished slice that proves the final experience without reproducing the full game.
State what the slice must prove about gameplay, art, narrative, technology, and production capability.
Playable area, characters, encounters, story beats, UI, progression, and media goals.
Gacha monetization, full live service, full roster, full world, full online infrastructure, and other deferred systems.
Define expected player session length and reviewer path.
Working note: Complete this template only when the relevant design decision is actively being reviewed. Keep legacy evidence in Original Material and link to it rather than overwriting it.
